+def grasp_geometry(points: np.ndarray, table_z: float, fraction: float):
+    """Estimate a handle point and crosswise closing direction from the surface mesh."""
+    xy = points[:, :2]
+    center = xy.mean(axis=0)
+    _, _, vt = np.linalg.svd(xy - center, full_matrices=False)
+    long_axis = vt[0]
+    if long_axis[0] < 0:
+        long_axis = -long_axis
+    perp = np.array([-long_axis[1], long_axis[0]])
+    t = (xy - center) @ long_axis
+    u = (xy - center) @ perp
+    lo, hi = np.quantile(t, [0.01, 0.99])
+    edges = np.linspace(lo, hi, 21)
+    widths = []
+    for a, b in zip(edges[:-1], edges[1:]):
+        v = u[(t >= a) & (t < b)]
+        widths.append(np.quantile(v, 0.9) - np.quantile(v, 0.1) if len(v) > 8 else np.inf)
+    widths = np.asarray(widths)
+    # Compare the first/last fifth of the utensil.  The narrower endpoint is the handle end.
+    k = max(2, len(widths) // 5)
+    handle_at_low = np.nanmedian(widths[:k]) <= np.nanmedian(widths[-k:])
+    handle_t = lo + fraction * (hi - lo) if handle_at_low else hi - fraction * (hi - lo)
+    near = np.abs(t - handle_t) < 0.035 * (hi - lo)
+    if np.count_nonzero(near) < 8:
+        near = np.abs(t - handle_t) < 0.07 * (hi - lo)
+    xy_grasp = np.median(xy[near], axis=0)
+    closing = perp
+    if closing @ np.array([1.0, 0.0]) < 0:
+        closing = -closing
+    return np.array([xy_grasp[0], xy_grasp[1], table_z + 0.010]), closing, (handle_at_low, widths, hi-lo)
+
+
+def go_high(p, xy, quat, z=0.32):
+    p["move_ee"]([float(xy[0]), float(xy[1]), z], quat, speed=0.25, max_dq=0.08)
+

+def try_pick(s, p, name, points, table_z, fraction):
+    """One isolated lift test, always from the exact frozen reset state."""

+            raise RuntimeError(f"Could not lift {name} with tested handle grasps")
+        picks[name] = chosen
+
+    # Record the final, uninterrupted sequence from the frozen state.
+    s.reset()
+    s.record_start()

+        start = np.asarray(s.objects()[name]["position"], dtype=float)
